The Circuit JSON records are extracted unchanged from TMDS62LEVM's full-board
configuration in `ShiboSoftwareDev/customize-am62a-reference-design` at
`4f2eca96e9d00065ff1480be4989fbb8b4927a03`.

The source drawing frame belongs to the imported unowned-geometry component.
It is about 424 mm wide, while the physical board is about 136 mm wide. Its
silkscreen title block is below the board. Both are retained in the viewer;
they should not determine the initial board viewport.
